senses.gloss: , m. (בזז, with format. ך; v. בְּזִיזֵי) vessel, dish, censer (b. h. כף).
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Tamid 4:3">Tam. IV, 3</cite> entrails <he>הנתונים בב׳</he> which had been put in a vessel.
<cite ref="Mishnah Tamid 5:4">Ib. V, 4</cite>. <he>והב׳ היה וכ׳</he> in the larger vessel was the baz., filled to the brim with incense.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yoma 2:1:7">Y. Yoma II, 39ᶜ</cite>; a. fr.—Pl. <he>בְּזִיכִים</he>, <he>בְּזִיכִין</he>.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 4:14">Num. R. s. 4</cite> (expl. b. h. <cite ref="K01003"><he>כַּפּוֹת</he></cite>) <he>בְּזִיכֵי לבונה</he> censers.
